process_setup.DISCLOSURE: This 0.431 GPU-h setup term may be PARTLY DOUBLE-COUNTED. The measured s_per_generated_image is elapsed/n_images from the pilot reports, so it already amortises that run's pipeline construction and checkpoint load over its images. Adding a separate 25 s per invocation therefore charges some setup twice. It is kept as a deliberate upper bound because the new runs have many SMALL evaluations (80 images) where per-invocation setup is a much larger share than in the pilot's 280-image runs. Reconcile against the actual implementation before the figure is relied on: if dev checkpoints are scored within one process, most of this term disappears and the subtotal falls toward 2.045 GPU-h.

wall_time_hours.note: NOT GPU-hours. The GPUs are shared without a scheduler and availability is not guaranteed; only independently verified idle devices would be used.
